info.title: E-commerce API
info.description:
Production-minded e-commerce REST API.

### Conventions
- **Versioned** under `/api/v1`; breaking changes go to a new version.
- **Success** bodies are `{ "data": ... }`; lists add `"meta": { page, pageSize, total, totalPages }`.
- **Errors** are always `{ "error": { code, message, details, requestId } }` with a meaningful HTTP status.
- **Money** is integer minor units (`*Cents`) plus an ISO 4217 `currency`. Never floats.
- **Timestamps** are ISO 8601 UTC strings.

### Authentication
1. `POST /api/v1/auth/login` returns a short-lived **access token** (send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`)
   and sets a rotating **refresh token** in an `httpOnly` cookie scoped to `/api/v1/auth`.
2. When a call answers `401 TOKEN_EXPIRED`, call `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh` (the browser sends the cookie) and retry.

Click **Authorize** and paste an access token to try protected endpoints.
Development credentials (seed): `admin@example.com` / `customer@example.com`, password `Password123!`.

### Idempotency
`POST /payments` requires and `POST /orders` accepts an `Idempotency-Key` header: retrying with the same key returns the original response.

clientSecret.description: Pass to the provider SDK in the browser to complete the payment (never log it).

CartIssue.description: Why a line cannot be checked out as-is

addressId.description: One of my saved addresses; it is copied into the order

CreateOrderRequest.description: Checks out the current cart. Prices are taken from the catalog, never from the client.

slug.description: Generated from the name when omitted

name.description: Defaults to the attribute values joined with " / "

UpdateVariantRequest.description: SKU is immutable: order history refers to it.

slug.description: Generated from the name when omitted

paymentMethod.description: Token from the provider's client SDK. With the mock provider use one of: mock_card_success, mock_card_declined, mock_card_insufficient_funds

CreatePaymentRequest.description: The amount is always the order total; it cannot be sent.

quantity.description: Positive for PURCHASE/RETURN. Signed for ADJUSTMENT (negative = decrease).

get.description: Returns 200 while the process is running. Does not check dependencies.
Checks that every critical dependency (PostgreSQL, Redis) is reachable. Returns 503 when the instance should not receive traffic.

post.description: Creates a CUSTOMER account and signs it in. The refresh token is set as an httpOnly cookie.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Returns a short-lived access token and sets a rotating refresh token as an httpOnly cookie.

post.summary: Rotate the refresh token and get a new access token
post.description: Reads the refresh token from the httpOnly cookie. Each refresh token works once; reusing one revokes the whole session.
Revokes the current session and clears the refresh cookie. Idempotent.

get.description: Same document as `GET /auth/me`, next to the matching `PATCH /users/me`.

post.description: Revokes every active session; the client must sign in again.

patch.summary: Activate/deactivate a user or change roles (admin)
patch.description: Deactivating a user revokes all their sessions.

post.description: The first address is set as default automatically.

get.description: Active categories nested by parent, ordered by `sortOrder`.

slug.description: Generated from the name when omitted

delete.description: Soft delete. Fails with 409 while the category has sub-categories.

get.description:
Full-text search with filters, sorting and pagination.

Example: `/api/v1/products?search=headphones&category=audio&minPrice=50&maxPrice=400&availability=in_stock&sort=price_asc&page=1&pageSize=20`

Money in responses is always integer minor units (`*Cents`) plus the store `currency`.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: One brand or a comma-separated list

parameters.name: availability
parameters.description: Whether at least one active variant has stock

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Defaults to `relevance` when `search` is set, otherwise `newest`

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Admins only (requires products:read). Public requests always see ACTIVE products.

post.description: Creates the product, its variants and their initial stock in one transaction.

get.summary: Get a product with its variants
get.description: Accepts the product UUID or its slug (for SEO-friendly frontend URLs).

delete.description: Soft delete: order history keeps referencing the product.

get.description: Sorted by available stock ascending. Use `lowStock=true` to find variants to restock.

get.summary: Get the stock level of a variant (admin)
Stock movement ledger of a variant (admin)
get.description: Newest first. Each entry records the deltas and the resulting balances.

post.summary: Record a purchase, return or adjustment (admin)

get.description: Newest first. `product` is null for items that are no longer available.

post.summary: Save a product to my wishlist
post.description: Idempotent: saving a product twice keeps a single entry.

delete.summary: Remove a product from my wishlist
delete.description: Idempotent: removing a product that is not saved also succeeds. Returns the updated wishlist.

get.description: Prices, totals and availability are recalculated from the catalog on every read. Lines that cannot be bought carry an `issue`.

post.summary: Add a variant to my cart
post.description: If the variant is already in the cart its quantity is increased.

patch.summary: Change the quantity of a cart line

post.description:
Creates a PENDING order from the current cart in one transaction and reserves the stock.
Unpaid orders are cancelled automatically after `PENDING_ORDER_TTL_MINUTES`.

Send an `Idempotency-Key` so a retried request (e.g. after a timeout) returns the same order instead of failing.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Recommended. Unique key per logical operation (a UUID). Retries with the same key return the original response instead of repeating the operation.

get.description: Customers see their own orders. Users with `orders:read` see every order.

patch.description:
Valid transitions: PENDING→CONFIRMED|CANCELLED, CONFIRMED→PROCESSING|CANCELLED,
PROCESSING→SHIPPED|CANCELLED, SHIPPED→DELIVERED. Anything else returns 422.

Admins (`orders:update`) can perform any valid transition; customers can only cancel their own PENDING orders.
Cancelling releases reserved stock (or returns sold stock for confirmed orders).

post.description:
Creates a payment with the configured provider for one of my PENDING orders.
The result is asynchronous: the payment starts as PENDING and the provider later sends a
webhook that completes it (confirming the order) or fails it (the order stays payable).

**`Idempotency-Key` is required**: a retried request returns the original payment instead of charging twice.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Required. Unique key per logical operation (a UUID). Retries with the same key return the original response instead of repeating the operation.

502.description: Upstream provider unavailable; the request can be retried

get.summary: List the payment attempts of an order

post.description: Paid orders are refunded automatically when cancelled. Use this to retry a refund that failed; the order must be CANCELLED. Idempotent: refunding twice is a no-op.

get.summary: Get the invoice of an order
get.description: Invoices are generated by a background job shortly after the payment is confirmed.

post.description:
Called by the payment provider, not by the frontend.
Requests must carry a valid `x-webhook-signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hmac-sha256>` header computed over `<t>.<raw body>` with the shared secret; requests older than 5 minutes are rejected (replay protection).

Events: `payment.pending`, `payment.completed`, `payment.failed`, `payment.refunded`.
Duplicate deliveries are acknowledged with `duplicate: true` and have no effect.
